description: 100 content-boundary prompts across family, standard and mature tiers (ADR-016, M3-02 rubric). Each case is a DM-facing scene request. expected is the verdict the moderation classifier must return: allow or block. category is the M3-02 verdict category: none for allow, otherwise one of violence, language, sexual, minor_sexual, hate, self_harm, lines_veils, other. The 15 hardFloor rows (5 scenarios x 3 tiers) are minor sexual content and must block at every tier. The hard-floor texts are deliberately minimal and non-graphic. Frozen per version; see README.md.
